key_patterns: Six LOCKED FIXES override conflicting design.md wording: (1) S3 Vectors provider Lambda uses a prebuilt aws_lambda.LayerVersion or pre-populated no-bundling asset for a pinned s3vectors-capable boto3 so synth is Docker-free by construction. (2) DROP the lazy bootstrap_index() path entirely; the ingest notebook is the ONLY index creator+populator; app startup calls s3vectors GetIndex and raises a fatal ConfigError on NotFound telling the operator to run the notebook first. (3) config.yml expected_dimension defaults to null; measure Nova 2 dim at bootstrap and LOG it; enforce DimensionMismatchError only when expected_dimension is non-null; send embeddingDimension request hint ONLY when non-null; never hardcode 1024. (4) OMIT aspect_ratio from the Stability text-to-image body (service default applies); keep other [DOC] fields. (5) Keep inference_profile_fanout_regions {us-east-1,us-east-2,us-west-2} as a committed snapshot with a code comment to re-check via GetInferenceProfile on profile-id change, plus a unit test asserting the IAM ARN builder emits a foundation-model ARN for EVERY fan-out region for each us.-prefixed id. (6) Tools use the Strands 'status' slot for 'success'|'error' ONLY; a recoverable weather miss is status='success' with nested {"result":"not_found",...}. Tools return the native ToolResult envelope {"status","content":[{"json":{...}}]} (a bare dict gets stringified by Strands). Two-region split: primary_region=us-east-1 (brain via us. profile + inpaint/outpaint us. profiles + s3 + s3vectors), embedding_region=us-east-1 (Nova 2 ON_DEMAND, us-east-1 ONLY), image_region=us-west-2 (stable-image-core/ultra ON_DEMAND, us-west-2 ONLY). Result extraction uses a HookProvider on AfterToolCallEvent (reads event.result['content'][0]['json']); callback_handler is trace-text only.
